labs.title: 8086 Assembly Exercise
labs.subject: Microprocessor Lab
labs.description: Sum an array of bytes and store the result — uses tabs for alignment, as written in the lab sheet.
labs.code:
; Lab 3 - Sum of an array (8086, MASM/TASM syntax)
.MODEL SMALL
.STACK 100h

.DATA
	ARR	DB	05h, 0Ah, 14h, 1Eh, 28h
	LEN	EQU	5
	SUM	DW	?

.CODE
MAIN PROC
	MOV	AX, @DATA
	MOV	DS, AX

	XOR	AX, AX		; AX = 0 (running sum)
	MOV	CX, LEN		; loop counter
	LEA	SI, ARR		; SI -> first element

NEXT:
	ADD	AL, [SI]
	ADC	AH, 0
	INC	SI
	LOOP	NEXT

	MOV	SUM, AX

	MOV	AH, 4Ch		; return to DOS
	INT	21h
MAIN ENDP
END MAIN
